items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; he was confirmed ACTIVE and played through calf issue vs Raiders, leading targets.
items.why: Weekend injury summary optimism path confirmed by actives
items.implication: WR1 lock continues with Adams out
items.opportunity: Elevated target share without Davante Adams

items.text: ETR listed Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM; confirmed INACTIVE Week 7, Allen handled ground work.
items.opportunity: Full backfield to Braelon Allen type

items.text: ETR EXPECTED TO PLAY Saquon Barkley; confirmed ACTIVE MNF, played limited but efficient then back issue late; postgame hamstring fine, back not expected to sideline.
items.why: Expected path hit; post comments positive on hamstring/back

items.text: McCaffrey mild hamstring strain (was quad); Shanahan pretty optimistic for Week 9 post-bye vs Raiders; returned to game.
items.implication: Bye rest helps; handcuff Black elevated

items.text: Levitan: Think Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain; later reports OK especially with bye.
items.why: Felt something on long run/slide; Garafolo positive with bye
items.implication: Monitor but stash; volume if Tracy also limited

items.text: Levitan on Gibbs ankle from purposeful slide: almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
ETR listed Lamar Jackson OUT Week 7 (ankle); reports optimistic for Week 8 return vs Bills pending practice.
items.why: Confirmed miss; confidence for next week
items.implication: Huntley streamer short-term; Lamar stash ROS

items.text: ETR OUT DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks; opened targets for others including slot in PHI vs DAL.
items.implication: Elevated role for remaining PHI pass catchers
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Goedert/others or Lemon type

items.text: ETR listed Josh Jacobs IN; returned and back in Packers backfield mix.
items.implication: RB volume returns; ROS value discussion

items.text: Berry: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner EPA/YPC but fantasy RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + league-lead 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Hold/start despite bad YPC; volume sustains

items.text: Berry: Tony Pollard EXPLODED; if you can turn big game into sell-high, take it.
items.implication: Sell high in trades for more consistent asset

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24 lead on 29 dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return; Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell limited role

items.text: Chiefs WR routes without Rice: Worthy 33 of 36 dropbacks but never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games; ceiling capped.
items.why: Route lead but historical yds ceiling
items.implication: Volume play but limited upside without Rice return
